newsitem.title: TURKEY: SOCCER-FENERBAHCE PLAYER STABBED BY RIVAL FANS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FENERBAHCE PLAYER STABBED BY RIVAL FANS.

text.p: Fenerbahce player Oner Canbolat was stabbed by rival fans in Istanbul late on Tuesday, daily sports paper Fotomac reported on Wednesday.
"They all jumped on top of me. When they separated us, I noticed I had been stabbed," the paper quoted Canbolat as saying.
It said a group of 15 to 20 youths shouting "dirty Fenerbahce" pounced on Canbolat and stabbed him in the stomach and groin after noticing he was wearing a Fenerbahce jacket.
Canbolat was taken to hospital where his condition was not thought to be serious. He said he believed the attackers were supporters of arch-rivals Galatasaray, beaten 3-2 by Fenerbahce on Saturday.
